title: VIREON
results: A distinctive website concept connecting biogas engineering with a clearer digital story.
summary: A website concept for a biogas engineering company transforming organic waste into renewable energy.

chapters.title: Project overview
chapters.heading: Energy with a new perspective
chapters.text: VIREON is a website concept for a biogas engineering company that turns organic waste into renewable energy. The project presents a technical field through an approachable digital identity, showing how practical infrastructure can contribute to a more circular future.

chapters.title: Business & user challenge
chapters.heading: Make complex work easy to understand
chapters.text: The concept needed to explain the company’s solutions, expertise and projects without losing the scale of its engineering work. A clear content hierarchy helps visitors move from the broader promise of renewable energy to the specific processes and capabilities behind it.

images.alt: VIREON website screens and industrial imagery

chapters.title: Structure & visual direction
chapters.heading: Where industry meets nature
chapters.text: Industrial photography grounds the experience in real equipment and operations. Organic 3D compositions create a visual bridge to natural systems, while bold typography and warm yellow accents give the subject a confident, memorable identity.

images.alt: VIREON page designs and content sections

chapters.title: Final design & adaptation
chapters.heading: A cohesive experience across screens
chapters.text: The page system pairs generous editorial layouts with concise explanations and project imagery. Responsive compositions carry the same rhythm to smaller screens, and subtle motion adds energy without competing with the content.

chapters.title: Outcome & next steps
chapters.heading: A complete visual direction
chapters.text: The resulting concept brings together a structured company narrative, responsive page designs and a consistent visual language. It offers a foundation for presenting VIREON’s solutions and future projects as the company’s story grows.

images.alt: VIREON visual identity, typography, colors and icons

title: VEYA
results: A refined shopping experience spanning catalogue, product details, cart and checkout.
summary: A conceptual e-commerce website for a boutique brand of designer table lamps.

chapters.title: Project overview
chapters.heading: Light as part of living
chapters.text: VEYA is a conceptual e-commerce experience for a boutique brand of designer table lamps. The idea presents lighting as an essential part of an interior’s atmosphere and character, bringing sculptural objects into the context of everyday living.

chapters.title: Business & user challenge
chapters.heading: Expression with a clear path to purchase
chapters.text: The experience needed to give each lamp a distinct presence while helping visitors explore, compare and buy with ease. A straightforward journey connects the homepage, catalogue, product information, shopping cart and checkout.

chapters.title: Structure & visual direction
chapters.heading: A warm, sculptural identity
chapters.text: Expressive typography and carefully framed product imagery give VEYA an editorial feel. Deep burgundy, warm neutrals and soft ivory create a refined palette that lets the forms, materials and glow of the lamps take focus.

images.alt: VEYA visual identity and brand application

chapters.title: Final design & adaptation
chapters.heading: From discovery to checkout
chapters.text: The key e-commerce pages balance brand storytelling with familiar shopping patterns. Product details clarify the object and its qualities, while the cart and checkout keep the final steps direct and easy to follow.

chapters.title: Outcome & next steps
chapters.heading: A complete commerce concept
chapters.text: The concept brings the visual identity into a cohesive website system, from first impression to purchase. It establishes a distinctive foundation for presenting a growing collection of designer lighting.

images.alt: VEYA designer lamp product detail pages

title: EPOCH
results: An expedition website concept connecting scientific credibility with the thrill of discovery.
summary: A website concept for an agency offering paleontological tours, fossil hunting expeditions and lectures.

chapters.title: Project overview
chapters.heading: A gateway to deep time
chapters.text: EPOCH is a website concept for an agency that organizes paleontological tours, fossil hunting trips and lectures. It invites curious travelers to experience prehistoric life firsthand while introducing the expertise behind each expedition.

chapters.title: Business & user challenge
chapters.heading: Build trust and spark curiosity
chapters.text: An expedition asks visitors to commit time and travel to an unfamiliar environment. The website therefore needs to make the offer understandable, convey scientific rigor and professionalism, and leave room for the excitement of discovery.

chapters.title: Structure & visual direction
chapters.heading: The atmosphere of discovery
chapters.text: A visual language drawn from prehistoric landscapes and fossil forms gives the project its sense of adventure. Strong type, evocative imagery and clear information hierarchy connect that atmosphere to a credible agency experience.

chapters.title: Final design & adaptation
chapters.heading: From exploration to expedition
chapters.text: The page system introduces the agency, its tours and educational experiences in a guided sequence. Responsive layouts keep the imagery compelling and the essential trip information legible across desktop and mobile screens.

chapters.title: Outcome & next steps
chapters.heading: A distinctive agency concept
chapters.text: The final concept offers a cohesive way to present paleontology as both a scientific discipline and an adventure. It provides a visual and structural foundation for future tours, lectures and expedition stories.

title: Art Scale
results: A premium store concept for rare, high-fidelity scale car models across desktop, tablet and mobile.
summary: A premium e-commerce concept for collectors of rare, historically accurate scale car models.

chapters.title: Project overview
chapters.heading: Collecting with precision
chapters.text: Art Scale is an educational, premium e-commerce concept for collectors of scale car models. It focuses on rare, high-fidelity pieces where historical accuracy, authenticity and craftsmanship are central to the appeal.

chapters.title: Business & user challenge
chapters.heading: Serve a passionate niche audience
chapters.text: Collectors need to understand the details that make each model special and move through the store without friction. The concept balances a considered presentation of rare objects with clear navigation and an efficient shopping journey.

images.alt: Art Scale website screens for collectible models

chapters.title: Structure & visual direction
chapters.heading: A refined system for fine details
chapters.text: A minimal interface echoes the precision of scale modelling. Restrained typography, deliberate spacing and focused product imagery reinforce the boutique brand’s premium position while keeping information easy to scan.

chapters.title: Final design & adaptation
chapters.heading: Consistent across every screen
chapters.text: The responsive system adapts to desktop, tablet and mobile without losing its hierarchy. Catalogue and product views give the models room to be appreciated while preserving clear paths through the shopping experience.

images.alt: Art Scale catalogue and product website screens

chapters.title: Outcome & next steps
chapters.heading: A premium commerce foundation
chapters.text: The final concept brings a distinct visual language and an intuitive store structure together for a specialist audience. It provides a flexible foundation for a growing collection of authentic scale models.

title: CENARTA Gallery
results: A contemporary gallery website concept with a restrained, artwork-first interface.
summary: A clean, expressive website concept that highlights the artworks and reflects a modern gallery identity.

chapters.title: Project overview
chapters.heading: A digital space for art
chapters.text: CENARTA is a contemporary website concept for an art gallery. Its purpose is to present the gallery and its artworks in a digital setting that feels as considered as the physical exhibition space.

chapters.title: Business & user challenge
chapters.heading: Let the work lead
chapters.text: A gallery website needs to help visitors discover art and understand the gallery’s point of view. The interface must make navigation effortless while leaving visual room for individual artworks to hold attention.

images.alt: CENARTA Gallery style, color and typography

chapters.title: Structure & visual direction
chapters.heading: Minimal, but expressive
chapters.text: A restrained composition, clean typography and deliberate spacing provide a quiet framework for the collection. Expressive details give the gallery a contemporary identity without competing with the art.

chapters.title: Final design & adaptation
chapters.heading: An exhibition across screens
chapters.text: The page system brings artworks, gallery information and visual storytelling into a coherent experience. Responsive layouts preserve the same clarity and focus when visitors explore on smaller screens.

images.alt: CENARTA Gallery artwork and exhibition pages

chapters.title: Outcome & next steps
chapters.heading: A modern gallery presence
chapters.text: The concept establishes a flexible visual foundation for presenting artists and artworks online. It gives CENARTA a recognizable digital presence while keeping the collection at the center of the experience.

title: The FORMA
results: A distinctive digital identity and promotional website for handmade ceramics.
summary: A promotional website concept celebrating the sculptural individuality of handmade ceramics.

chapters.title: Project overview
chapters.heading: Objects with a sculptural voice
chapters.text: The FORMA is a promotional website concept for handmade ceramics. It treats each piece as an individual work, bringing the brand’s tactile materials and organic forms into a distinctive digital setting.

chapters.title: Business & user challenge
chapters.heading: Show the character of every piece
chapters.text: The experience needs to communicate the value of handmade objects while inviting visitors to explore the collection. A focused structure gives the ceramics space to be seen and makes the brand story easy to follow.

chapters.title: Structure & visual direction
chapters.heading: Organic form meets modern restraint
chapters.text: The design system draws from sculptural silhouettes, tactile surfaces and modern minimalism. Expressive typography and refined compositions create an enduring visual identity that complements the individuality of each object.

chapters.title: Final design & adaptation
chapters.heading: An expressive promotional experience
chapters.text: Generous layouts and carefully staged imagery turn the collection into a visual narrative. The responsive page system carries the same clarity and atmosphere across screens, with details that keep the work itself in focus.

images.alt: The FORMA ceramic collection website pages

chapters.title: Outcome & next steps
chapters.heading: Everyday objects, presented as art
chapters.text: The final concept connects brand identity and website design in one cohesive experience. It gives The FORMA a flexible foundation for introducing new pieces and sharing the craft behind them.
